description: This file defines a PHP trait named IndexingSchedulerTrait in the SuiteCRM\Search\Index namespace. It provides a static method schedulerJob() responsible for scheduling indexing jobs that interact with an AbstractIndexer instance, handling configuration options, logging, and error management.

methods.name: schedulerJob
methods.description: A static method that initiates a scheduled indexing job if enabled, sets options, logs progress and errors, and returns a boolean indicating success or failure.
